name: Venomancer: Wasp Form grants flight through its helper aura (#3476)
contract: #3476: Wasp Form 805141 reads 'increasing movement speed by $805142s2% and allowing you to fly'. Spell.dbc: 805141 has aura 36 (shapeshift, form 29), aura 56 (transform 5441) and aura 206 (flight speed), none of which grants flight; the helper 805142 holds aura 31 (speed) and aura 201 (SPELL_AURA_FLY) but nothing ever applied it. aura_ascension_venomancer_wasp_form now applies 805142 with the form and removes it when the form ends. Cast in Hellfire Peninsula (game_tele 475).
